purpose: Cross-skill routing eval for the 7 cfgver-* skills. Each query has ONE expected winner among: cfgver, cfgver-executor, cfgver-refinement, cfgver-soundness, cfgver-contracts, cfgver-endtoend, cfgver-memory, rocq (generic plugin skill), rocq:golf, or none. A cfgver-* skill firing on a query expected elsewhere = mis-route.
notes: Q16 is a deliberate easy sanity check. Q19 also probes a known body-content gap (_tbl machinery) but routing-wise executor is correct. Q8 expects cfgver-wp2 (soundness/wp2 split). Skill set under test: 11 cfgver-family skills + gmap-pitfalls (2026-07-16 restructure: rsolve craft split from refinement; endtoend-internals added; registers.md is a references file, not a skill). Q1/Q9 expect cfgver-rsolve. Q4/Q10/Q20 expect the contracts USER GUIDE; a query about modifying gen_implpre itself would expect cfgver-contracts-internals (no such query yet — consider adding one).
